segments.text: Now how does appliances connected in domestic wiring?
segments.zh: 那么在家庭布线中电器是怎么连接的？

segments.text: Remember that whatever the components you are using in your house all the equipments are connected in parallel only.
segments.zh: 记住，你家里使用的所有元件、所有设备都是并联的。

segments.text: Parallel.
segments.zh: 并联。

segments.text: Parallel or shunt connection.
segments.zh: 并联或者说分路连接。

segments.text: Why?
segments.zh: 为什么？

segments.text: Because every socket we should get 230 volt.
segments.zh: 因为每个插座都应该得到 230 伏电压。

segments.text: Every points if you take any two points we should get the potential difference of 230.
segments.zh: 任意取两个点，都应该得到 230 伏的电位差。

segments.text: If it is serious means problem.
segments.zh: 如果是串联的话就会有问题。

segments.text: The main issue is if one of the equipment is disconnected or something is happened.
segments.zh: 主要问题是，如果其中一台设备断开或者出了什么问题，

segments.text: The entire supply will be disconnected.
segments.zh: 整个供电就会断开。

segments.text: Why?
segments.zh: 为什么？

segments.text: Because in case of serious circuit the voltage across the components will be different.
segments.zh: 因为在串联电路中，各元件两端的电压不同。

segments.text: But in case of parallel circuit voltage across the components remains same.
segments.zh: 而在并联电路中，各元件两端的电压保持不变，

segments.text: But current will be different.
segments.zh: 但电流不同。

segments.text: So normally we prefer the parallel connection only in our domestic wiring.
segments.zh: 所以通常我们在家庭布线中只采用并联连接。

segments.text: In domestic wiring the shunt or parallel connection is compulsory.
segments.zh: 在家庭布线中，分路或者说并联连接是必须的。

segments.text: Otherwise it won't work out.
segments.zh: 否则就无法正常工作。
